overview.title: What is Material Brain?
overview.body: A library of your filaments. Each profile stores temps, density, and the maximum volumetric flow the filament can sustain - the numbers tuning and slicing build on.

flow.title: Flow vs hotend ceiling
flow.body: Each profile's max volumetric flow is cross-checked against your hotend's catalog ceiling, so a profile asking for more than the hotend can melt is flagged before it shows up as under-extrusion.

volumetricFlow.def: How much plastic (mm³) the hotend melts per second - the real speed limit for fast printing.

density.def: Filament mass per volume (g/cm³); used to convert volumetric flow to a mass rate.

ceiling.def: The maximum volumetric flow a hotend can sustain, from the hardware catalog.
